name: privacy-gateway
description: PII and secrets are swapped for placeholders (__PII_PERSON_1__) by regex and a local Gemma 4 before anything reaches Claude; placeholders are restored only where the work stays on this machine (local tool calls) and on screen.

gemmaUrl.title: Gemma endpoint
gemmaUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint of the local model (LM Studio, mlx_lm.server).

onDetectorError.title: When Gemma fails
onDetectorError.description: "block" (default): the content is not sent to Claude. "regex-only": the content is sent masked by the regex detectors alone.

detectionScope.title: Detection scope
detectionScope.description: "full" (default): engine-written text (skill listings, MCP instructions, system prompt sections) is checked by Gemma too. "fast": that text is masked by regex and known values only, so the first request fits the 30-second fetch limit more easily, but names inside user-written skill descriptions pass through.

images.title: Images and documents
images.description: "drop" (default): image and document blocks are removed, since they cannot be masked. "pass": they are sent as they are.
